title: Deep pothole near market entrance
description: There is a crater in the middle of the road right before the main vegetable market. Vehicles are getting damaged daily.

title: Broken slab on pedestrian walkway

title: Sunken trench on arterial street

title: Missing curb stones causing edge collapse

title: Tarmac peeling off on newly paved lane

title: Exposed rebar in broken bridge expansion joint
description: Metal reinforcement rods are sticking out of the concrete gap on the overpass.

title: Mud and slurry covering street after construction

title: Street surface worn down to bare foundation rocks

title: Deep rutting in bus bay lane
description: Heavy bus tyres have pressed two deep troughs into the soft asphalt, trapping bicycle wheels.

title: Pothole cluster near railway underpass
description: Four consecutive deep hollows in the road underpass cause waterlogging and traffic to stall.

title: Missing road shoulder barrier
description: Guardrail on the curve has been sheared off, leaving vehicles vulnerable to rolling down the bank.

title: Sharp elevation step between old and new asphalt

title: Sidewalk paving flags caved into telecom pit

title: Loose iron plate covering road excavation

description: Road has settled unevenly over the underground stream, launching vehicles that pass at normal speeds.

description: A submerged hole on Station Road is causing scooter riders to lose balance and fall.

title: Broken concrete curb puncturing tires
description: Shattered curbstone has jagged granite pointing directly into the travel lane.

title: Unpaved connection between two main streets
description: A 50-meter gap between two tarred sectors is just dirt and boulders, damaging suspensions.

title: Street level elevated above house thresholds

title: Dislodged speed breaker rubber segments
description: Bolts are sticking up out of the road where speed cushions have torn away.

title: Road shoulder washed away by monsoon flow

title: Deep gouges in tarmac from construction machinery
description: Bulldozer tracks ripped up the fresh road surface outside the commercial complex.

title: Crumbled asphalt around storm water grating

title: Continuous trench left unpaved for six months

title: Crater near hospital emergency entrance
description: Ambulances must slow to a crawl because of a wide broken road patch right at the gate.

title: Broken steps on public pedestrian overbridge
description: Concrete tread has broken off on the skywalk staircase, presenting a severe fall hazard.

title: Tar bleeding in hot weather creating slippery ruts
description: Excess asphalt binder has softened and created greasy ridges that reduce vehicle braking.

title: Large rock fell from cutting onto highway lane
description: Boulder from the hill cutting landed on the outer lane, narrowing the passage.

title: Excessive salinity in municipal water supply

title: Water supply schedule changed without intimation

title: Water smells strongly of sulfur and rotten eggs

title: Weak pressure at tail end of the distribution network

title: Fly tipping of industrial plastic scraps

title: Commercial restaurant dumping cooking grease in ditch

title: Stagnant mountain of trash near transit interchange

title: Sanitation worker demanding festival tipping

title: Raw sewage mixed with solid waste on open plot
description: Unchecked garbage dumping has blocked surface runoff, creating a cesspool of trash and muck.

title: Car repair garage dumping scrap metal on pavement
description: Automobile workshop leaves rusty exhausts, fenders, and oily parts on the pedestrian path.

title: Unsegregated wet and dry waste dumped together

title: Discarded thermocol foam blowing across expressway
description: White polystyrene packaging boxes broke open and styrofoam flakes are blinding highway drivers.

title: Dumpster catching fire due to lit cigarette
description: Plastic waste inside the municipal trash container is smoldering and producing acrid black fumes.

title: Hazardous paint cans and thinner dumped in alley
description: Chemical solvent containers left behind an apartment building, strong fumes causing dizziness.

title: Public bin overflowing directly opposite school gate
description: Students entering school must step through rotting fruit peels and soggy trash bags.

title: Discarded coconut shells accumulating rainwater
description: Piles of green coconut husks dumped by street vendors are holding water and breeding mosquitoes.

title: Illegal demolition waste dumped on river bank
description: Concrete slabs and plaster debris are choking the river bank promenade.

title: No evening sweeping in busy commercial market
description: After evening trading, market lanes are ankle-deep in vegetable cartons and plastic wrappers.

title: Dumpster tipped over on its side by vehicle
description: The heavy metal waste bin is lying overturned with its contents spilled over the sidewalk.

title: Massive trash heap blocking emergency fire lane
description: Residential building fire exit route is completely obstructed by piled refuse sacks.

title: Streetlight out on entire stretch of Park Road
description: Ten consecutive lamp posts are completely dark, making the road unsafe for walking at night.

title: Sparks flying from overhead distribution transformer
description: Loud buzzing and visible orange electrical arcs coming from the pole-mounted transformer box.

title: Snapped power line dangling onto wet ground
description: A high voltage electric cable has snapped and is resting on the puddle outside our gate.

title: Streetlight lamp flickering rapidly every night

description: Metal cover on the electric pole base is missing, leaving energized bare copper busbars exposed.

title: Underground cable junction smoking on sidewalk
description: Smell of burning rubber and white smoke rising from a subterranean electrical inspection hatch.

title: Lamp post damaged in car collision leaning over road
description: Steel pole was struck by a vehicle; it is bent in half and hanging by its power cables.

title: Total blackout in Block C while adjacent blocks have power

title: Exposed conductor touching sheet metal roof of shed

title: Traffic light stuck permanently on red in Northbound lane

description: Flexible plastic lane posts have been flattened and cars are crossing over into oncoming lanes.
